values.note: Overnight RV sites listed on the operator's site take campers under 21 ft (61B) to under 42 ft (45); 58 takes under 29 ft, 61c under 32 ft, 62 under 38 ft. 45/46 and 73/74 can be driven through when the neighbouring site is empty. Most of the park's other sites are annual seasonal leases.

values.note: Wi-Fi at the office and game room only. Firewood sold at the camp store.

facilities.source: https://rosecreekfamilycampground.com/ ('Two Bathhouses with hot showers'; 'Camp store'; 'Wi-fi at Office & Game Room') + /policies-%26-faqs (firewood bundles at the campstore), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Season runs from the first weekend in April through the last weekend in October; the 2026 season's last day is November 1.

season.source: https://rosecreekfamilycampground.com/ ('Our season typically runs from the first weekend in April until the last weekend in October. Our last day of operation of 2026 will be November 1st.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Open for the rest of the 2026 season (ends November 1). Hurricane Helene (2024) took out the walking bridge at sites 64-66; it will not be rebuilt.

status.source: https://rosecreekfamilycampground.com/ ('Last day of the 2026 season is November 1st') + /sites ('Helene took out our walking bridge at sites 64-66. As of right now we do not have plans to rebuild the bridge'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Reservations by phone (828-821-1610) or the website's inquiry form, with a one-night deposit; no online booking. 'Reservations are required to access' the campground. Tents and pop-ups 7 nights at most; campers 30.

booking.source: https://rosecreekfamilycampground.com/policies-%26-faqs ('reservations must be made in advance by phone'; 'During Holiday weekends only there is a minimum stay requirement of 2 nights'; 'Maximum stay in your camper is 30 days') + /sites ('Reservations are required to access Rose Creek Family Campground'), read 2026-10-22

note: Family campground on Rose Creek off NC-181 in Burke County (Morganton), with tent sites, a creek wading beach, a fishing pond, trails and a game room. Most sites are annual seasonal leases (waiting list); a smaller set of RV and tent sites is kept for overnight guests. --Claude
summary: Operator site: confirmed 30/50-amp full hookups, phone-only reservations, 30-night camper maximum and the posted $45 (30-amp FH) to $55 (50-amp FH) rates (fees left as recorded 2026-10-14). Added a 2-night holiday-weekend minimum, fcfs never (reservations required to enter), max rig 41 ft (site 45 'less than 42 ft'), showers/camp store/Wi-Fi at office, season first weekend of April to last weekend of October (2026 ends Nov 1), status open. Note trimmed of hookups/season/max-stay/bathhouse text. Not stated: site count, flush toilets, dump.
flags: Mostly seasonal: the park sells annual lot leases ($1,800-2,000/yr, all full with a waiting list) and its sites page lists only about 8 overnight RV sites (45, 46, 58, 61B, 61c, 62, 73, 74) plus ~10 tent/pop-up sites, with site numbers running past 74. That is roughly a quarter of sites sold nightly, so long-stay test 4 (1 in 10) passes; it posts nightly rates and bars residential stays ('we do not allow long-term or residential stays').
Price gate: base $45 (30-amp full hookup) is under US$50; no gateway within 40 km (Asheville 74 km). Family has not stayed here.
